title: lagenocarpus martii f. dioicus

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lagenocarpus martii f. dioicus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help in relieving symptoms of colds, flu, and other infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
